stories.summary: Coconut and jaggery have decadent flavours. This duo is a classic combination in many traditional Indian sweets. The rich, nutty and earthy sweetness is blissful. If this combo is your favourite, then you can savour it in a traditional Assamese delicacy. Chef Ranjan Majumdar, executive chef at Mayfair Spring Valley Resort, Guwahati, shared the recipe for warm fluffy Bhapa Pitha with HT Lifestyle.

stories.title: Pan-Indian study finds that higher levels of DNA fragments in blood strengthen cancer signals
stories.summary: A blood test that looks for cancer-related changes in DNA has shown the potential to detect multiple types of cancer. 4%. The blood test, CancerSpot, developed by Bengaluru-based Strand Life Sciences, uses DNA sequencing and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to identify changes in DNA that can indicate the presence of cancer.

stories.title: ICMR launches infectious disease surveillance network for early outbreak warnings
stories.summary: The Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) has launched a syndromic surveillance initiative for infectious diseases, a mechanism designed to provide early warnings of disease outbreaks, people familiar with the matter said. The syndromic surveillance under the department of health research Virus Research and Diagnostic Laboratories (VRDL) scheme will create an early-warning network for outbreaks across 70 VRDLs and Infectious Disease Research & Diagnostic Laboratories (IRDLs).

stories.title: FSSAI licences of four restaurants in Hyderabad suspended over food safety violations
stories.summary: The Telangana Standards Authority for Food and Essential Drugs (TG SAFE) suspended the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) licences of Alpha Hotel and Stores and Lodge in Secunderabad, Laham House in Jubilee Hills and two other restaurants following inspections that revealed serious hygiene violations, including cockroach and housefly infestations, clogged drains and improper food storage.

stories.title: Scientists warn of growing health threats of chemicals found everywhere
stories.summary: Chemicals found almost everywhere in modern life pose a "global and growing threat" to human health and the environment, a landmark report based on over a decade of research has warned. The report on "endocrine-disrupting chemicals" (EDCs) released by the United Nations Environment Programme and World Health Organization "conservatively" estimates the health and environmental costs of EDC exposure at over $1 trillion annually.

stories.title: Health Department and Rotary Club of Madras partner to take forward HPV vaccination
stories.summary: Tamil Nadu’s Health Department is partnering with the Rotary Club of Madras for HPV vaccination against cervical cancer. The partnership was launched at an event in the city on Wednesday. Health officials said that this was to create awareness about HPV vaccination in schools for students, teachers and parents.

stories.title: Can festive eating cause acne? How sugar, late nights, and poor sleep affect your skin
stories.summary: Festive times are always a great time to eat lots of great food and treats and stay up late. However, this can be bad for your skin. Eating different foods, changing your sleeping patterns and not sticking to your normal daily routine can affect how good your skin looks.

stories.title: Tongue cancer: 5 lesser-known facts about the disease and its early warning signs everyone should know
stories.summary: Tongue cancer has been associated with several risk factors, including tobacco use, frequent alcohol consumption, increasing age, certain strains of human papillomavirus (HPV), and a weakened immune system . However, these factors are not present in every case, and tongue cancer can occur in people of different ages and backgrounds, including those with no history of tobacco use.

stories.title: Winter halwa recipe: Try this healthy five-grain halwa tart with fresh berries and crunchy seeds
stories.summary: Winter is synonymous with halwa. Its decadent taste and rich aroma fill you with warmth on chilly days. You are probably familiar with favourites like gajar ka halwa, moong dal ka halwa and badam halwa. If you are trying to eat a little healthier, you might be tempted to skip halwa altogether.

stories.title: IND Vs NZ 1st Test: Jasprit Bumrah, Anshul Kamboj Strike Early As India Remove New Zealand Openers; VIDEO
stories.summary: India got off to a flying start with the ball as Indian pacers Jasprit Bumrah and Anshul Kamboj struck early to dismiss both New Zealand openers during IND Vs NZ 1st Test at the Basin Reserve in Wellington on Thursday.

stories.title: India leave Siraj and Jadeja out of opening Test in New Zealand
stories.summary: Fast bowler Mohammed Siraj was not included in India’s playing XI for the first Test against New Zealand in Wellington on Thursday. India captain Shubman Gill, who hinted at going in with four fast bowlers before the game, revealed Jasprit Bumrah, Prasidh Krishna, Anshul Kamboj, and Akash Deep would make up the team’s pace attack on a green wicket at the Basin Reserve.

stories.title: India win toss, opt to field against New Zealand in opening Test
stories.summary: Shubman Gill’s love affair with calling tails and winning the toss continued as the India captain had no hesitation in opting to field in the first Test against New Zealand on a breezy and sunny morning at the Basin Reserve.

stories.title: AIFF lodges complaint over alleged racist gesture by Palestine player
stories.summary: The All India Football Federation (AIFF) has lodged a complaint with the Asian Football Confederation accusing a Palestinian player of making a racist gesture towards India captain Dallalmuon Gangte during the two teams' AFC U17 Asian Cup Qualifier match in Kuala Lumpur. The Indian U17 men's team trounced Palestine 4-1, overcoming heavy rain to remain unbeaten in Group E of the Qualifiers for the 2027 Asian Cup on Tuesday (November 17, 2026).

stories.title: Lakshya Sen seals World Tour Final spot after Srikanth knocks out Watanabe in Hong Kong
stories.summary: India's Lakshya Sen sealed his place in the BWF World Tour Finals after compatriot Kidambi Srikanth knocked out his closest rival, Japan's Koki Watanabe, in the men's singles first round of the Hong Kong Open Super 500 badminton tournament here on Wednesday.

stories.title: India docked 35 per cent of match fee for slow over-rate in fifth ODI
stories.summary: India were on Wednesday fined 35 per cent of their match fee for maintaining a slow over-rate against New Zealand in the fifth ODI in Mount Maunganui on November 15. Ranjan Madugalle of the ICC Elite Panel of Match Referees imposed the sanction after Shreyas Iyer 's side was ruled to be seven overs short of the target after time allowances were taken into consideration.

stories.title: Investigation into Air India crash that killed 260 in final stage, India says
stories.summary: NEW DELHI, - The investigation into last year's Air India crash that killed 260 people is in its final stage, the Indian government said on Wednesday. "We are at the fag end ," Solicitor General Tushar Mehta told the Supreme Court, which is hearing a petition by the father of the flight's captain, Sumeet Sabharwal, seeking a separate independent investigation into the accident.

stories.title: Duckett ton & impressive bowlers give England series win
stories.summary: England confidently swept aside Australia in the third one-day international in Hobart to seal a statement series win. At times the series decider felt inconsequential - the latest seismic turn in Australia's sandpaper scandal taking all attention during Australia's chase - but Harry Brook's side won by 97 runs in an important step as they build towards next year's World Cup.

stories.title: Lara Dutta and Mahesh Bhupathi's daughter Saira wins tennis championship in UAE, actor shares proud moment
stories.summary: Actor Lara Dutta is currently enjoying the success of her latest release, Ramayana . However, she has another reason to celebrate. The actor recently took to Instagram to share pictures from a tennis tournament featuring her daughter, Saira, who won a championship at the Tennis & Country Club in Fujairah, UAE.

stories.title: 2026 World Cup schedule and results
stories.summary: The Rising Stars Asia Cup 2026 is set to get underway in Doha, Qatar, on November 19, with eight teams competing for the title in the 50-over tournament. A total of 15 matches will be played across 10 days, with the tournament featuring two groups of four teams each.

stories.title: No room for Siraj: India leave out senior pacer despite four-man attack in 1st Test
stories.summary: India left out Mohammed Siraj despite opting for a four-man pace attack for the first Test against New Zealand at the Basin Reserve in Wellington on Thursday. "We were contemplating for the past one week which combination to, you know, go with because all of our fast bowlers have been doing really well.

stories.title: BCCI CEO and IPL COO Amin and IOA CEO Iyer to create framework for leagues in India
stories.summary: The committee will assess challenges facing the existing sports league ecosystem, identify priority sports and recommend ways to attract corporate investment, franchise ownership, sponsorships, broadcasting and digital rights, as well as Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) funding. "While several sports leagues in the country have achieved varying levels of success, many disciplines with strong sporting and social potential face commercial viability hurdles during their initial stages," the ministry said in a statement.

stories.title: ‘It was the whole team’: Bancroft opens up on Sandpapergate
stories.summary: Cameron Bancroft, one of the central figures of the 2018 ball-tampering scandal in South Africa, has asserted that the entire team knew about the conspiracy but he ended up taking “the bullet” for everyone. Bancroft, Steve Smith and David Warner were banned by Cricket Australia (CA) for their role in ‘Sandpapergate’.

stories.title: India seek a Test high at Basin Reserve
stories.summary: Two Tests are never enough to acclimatise and adapt to the way of cricket in any country, leave alone New Zealand . Barring the tour of 2008-09, India’s scheduling mandate has never risen above that in the last two decades.

stories.title: MS Dhoni’s IPL playing career: Milestones and records of the CSK icon
stories.summary: Mahendra Singh Dhoni officially ended his playing career on November 17, 2026, retiring from the Indian Premier League (IPL) on the retention deadline day for 2027 season. Dhoni’s IPL career began with the inaugural edition in 2008. He represented Chennai Super Kings (CSK) for 17 seasons, leading the franchise to five IPL titles in 2010, 2011, 2018, 2021 and 2023.

stories.title: Travis Head likely to miss IPL 2027: Report
stories.summary: Explosive Australia and Sunrisers Hyderabad opener Travis Head has decided to skip Indian Premier League 2027 to manage his workload ahead of a busy international schedule, according to a report. Head has informed his franchise about his decision to opt out of the upcoming season and SRH are expected to release him, according to Cricinfo.

stories.title: The sandpaper plot - who was there, who said what?
stories.summary: The sandpaper scandal, one of the biggest controversies in the history of Test cricket, continues to engulf Australian sport. Fresh evidence from Cameron Bancroft - the culprit of the ball-tampering in South Africa in 2018 - has heaped pressure on Australia captain Pat Cummins, former coach Darren Lehmann and Cricket Australia.

stories.title: Photos: India defeat Pakistan to win SAFF Championship in Bangladesh
stories.summary: whatsapp-stroke copylink google Add Al Jazeera on Google info By Md Razi Al Islam and Mahmud Hossain Opu Published On 18 Nov 2026 18 Nov 2026 On an evening of thrilling action, on-field drama and passionate support in the stands, India defeated Pakistan 2-1 to win the South Asian Football Federation (SAFF) Championship in Bangladesh.

stories.title: IND vs NZ, 1st test: Over-rate caveat to India’s pace attack
stories.summary: The last time India went into a Test with four genuine pacers was in South Africa in 2023-24. While the series is remembered for Dean Elgar’s heroics in the opening Test at Centurion and Jasprit Bumrah and Mohammed Siraj combining in Cape Town in the New Year week to help India draw the series, there was another aspect to it.

stories.title: China’s Xi, other leaders say Asia-Pacific must embrace open trade and fair growth
stories.summary: The Asia-Pacific must pursue more open trade and equitable growth if it is to remain stable and dynamic, Chinese President Xi Jinping told business executives gathered on Wednesday (November 18, 2026) in the southern Chinese technology and financial hub of Shenzhen, on the sidelines of the annual Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Summit.

stories.title: India Stun Pakistan 2-1 In SAFF Championship Final As Sandip Mandis 88th-Minute Winner Seals Historic 10th
stories.summary: Watch | X Dhaka: India scripted a dramatic comeback to defeat 10-man Pakistan 2-1 in the SAFF Championship final, with Sandip Mandi scoring an 88th-minute winner to secure the Blue Tigers' record-extending 10th title and a historic third consecutive crown.

stories.title: A light-day from home, Voyager 1 still runs on fading plutonium, with spare thrusters once believed dead | HT Explainers
stories.summary: On Tuesday night, Nasa asked people to flash V-G-R, Voyager’s call sign, at the sky in Morse code with their phones and torches. By Wednesday morning, the 49-year-old Voyager 1 was so far from Earth that the light from those torches would take a full day to reach it, a distance no other human-made object has travelled before.

stories.title: Who is Shrishti Sharma? Medical student from Maharashtra breaks own Guinness World Record in limbo skating
stories.summary: Education and sports together is difficult. 86 seconds. The record was achieved on October 8, 2026, in Umred, Maharashtra, where Shrishti completed the 50-metre course, surpassing her previous benchmark in the discipline. Sharma, who has earned recognition for her achievements in limbo skating, has established herself as a prominent name in the sport and holds multiple Guinness World Records titles.

stories.title: GTA 6 Launches Tonight: India Release Time, Price, Platforms, Preload Details, and Everything You Need to Know
stories.summary: After more than 13 years since the release of Grand Theft Auto V, Rockstar Games is finally bringing players the next mainline entry in its hugely popular open-world series. Grand Theft Auto VI is set to arrive today (November 19), taking players back to Vice City in the fictional state of Leonida.

stories.title: Can AI Run a Factory? Siemens Launches Eigen Engineering Agent in India
stories.summary: Siemens has launched its Eigen Engineering Agent in India, a purpose-built AI tool designed to handle automation engineering tasks. The system can perform PLC coding, HMI visualisation and device configuration within real engineering environments. Siemens says the agent has already been successfully piloted with more than 16 customers across India.

stories.title: How ISB began, and why its MBA model still matters 25 years later
stories.summary: As ISB celebrates its 25th year, founding dean Dr Pramath Raj Sinha and current dean Professor Madan Pillutla look back at the institution’s early years, the demand for management graduates in post-liberalisation India, the roadblocks they encountered, and why they believe an MBA will remain relevant in the age of artificial intelligence (AI).

stories.title: VinFast to launch 3 made-for-India electric scooters in 2027: Evo, Kyo and Kinet-based models explained
stories.summary: VinFast is preparing to enter India's electric two-wheeler market with three new electric scooters in 2027. The Vietnamese manufacturer will launch India-specific models of its Evo, Kyo and Kinet scooters, which will be modified in terms of design, chassis and performance to suit local riding conditions. The three models will be built in-house, but names and specifications have yet to be disclosed.

stories.title: Can an Italian raise slogans against govt while in India on visa? SC to hear PIL
stories.summary: Supreme Court on Monday agreed to hear a PIL asking whether it was legally permissible for an Italian visiting India on a conference visa, to raise the political slogan "vote chor, gaddi chhod" in support of opposition's campaign against Election Commission and Modi govt at the Bharat Summit organised by Telangana Congress govt in Hyderabad.The plea alleges Giacomo Filibeck, the secretary-general of the Party of European Socialists, raised the "vulgar, derogatory and demeaning political slogan"…

stories.title: Explained | All about the Cambay offshore block at the centre of Vedanta chair Anil Agarwal's tiff with the govt
stories.summary: Bhanu Pratap Published 19 Nov 2026, 12:00 AM IST Prefer Livemint on Google Vedanta chairman Anil Agarwal has criticised the Centre’s decision to transfer operations of the company’s producing Cambay offshore oil and gas block to state-run Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC), warning that the move could undermine investor confidence in India’s exploration and production sector.

stories.title: Will your flight ticket cost more from January 2027? India’s new aviation fuel rule explained
stories.summary: Booking a flight from January 2027 could come with a new cost pressure, although passengers may not immediately see it reflected in their tickets. India's aviation industry is preparing for a new sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) requirement, and the expense of switching to the cleaner fuel has left airlines seeking answers from the government on who will pay for it.

stories.title: Does India need to financially aid families’ decisions to have a child through fertility treatment?
stories.summary: The reproductive-autonomy jurisprudence as evolved by the Supreme Court under Article 21 of the Constitution is rich yet narrow, focusing primarily on one side of the problem. In Suchita Srivastava v. Chandigarh Administration (2009), the Court held that reproductive choices may be exercised to procreate as well as to abstain from procreating.

stories.title: How ONGC took over the Cambay block it co-owned with Vedanta; why Anil Agarwal is objecting? Explained
stories.summary: VOGL VEDL Sayantani Biswas Published 18 Nov 2026, 06:35 PM IST Prefer Livemint on Google Mining tycoon Anil Agarwal has raised concerns over the government's decision to hand over a producing offshore oil and gas block in Gujarat to state-run Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC), warning that the move could undermine investor confidence at a time when India is trying to attract more investment into domestic energy production.

stories.title: Gratuity before 5 years of service: Check when employees qualify; Karnataka High Court ruling explained
stories.summary: Employees who resign before completing five years of continuous service may still be eligible for gratuity if they meet certain conditions under the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972, the Karnataka High Court has ruled. The court held that an employee who has worked for at least 240 days during the relevant 12-month period may be deemed to have completed a full year of continuous service for the purpose of gratuity eligibility.

stories.title: Explainer-Congo’s Ebola outbreak is spreading and killing at a record pace
stories.summary: Despite an outpouring of aid, resource shortages, insecurity and poor coordination hamper efforts to contain the outbreak. Health workers have come under attack in communities that distrust outsiders. The outbreak, caused by the rare Bundibugyo species of the virus, is already the second-largest on record globally. Over 11,000 people have been infected and over 5,500 have died since it was declared on May 15, according to government data.

stories.title: What did India take home from Manila?
stories.summary: The Quad’s headline was critical minerals, with Trump announcing agreements to protect members from “coercion by any single foreign supplier”, though without naming China. The announcement echoed what I heard repeatedly in Washington earlier this year: That the Trump administration had eased its tariff confrontation with China because Beijing still held the minerals card, and that its later bilateral deals, including with India, had yet to add up to a strategy.

stories.title: Rs 5 coins allegedly melted to make dental crowns in Maharashtra: Risks of using uncertified metals explained
stories.summary: Dr Sharmishtha Lad, dentist and healthcare entrepreneur, explained that a dental crown, commonly called a tooth cap, is a protective covering placed over a damaged, weakened or heavily restored tooth. “It helps restore the tooth ‘s shape, strength and ability to function. com. The process usually begins with a dentist examining the tooth, preparing it where necessary and taking an impression or digital scan.

stories.title: When does the 24-hour countdown begin after arrest? Supreme Court answers
stories.summary: The Supreme Court on November 5, 2026, held that the 24 hours timeline as mandated under clause (2) of Article 22 of the Constitution of India would commence from the date and time of a person’s detention when their liberty is curtailed and not from the time of their formal arrest.

stories.title: Ambedkar feared MPs would tire of long sessions. The history & rules on Parliament calendar | HT Explainers
stories.summary: As questions have been raised over the schedule for Parliament’s winter session, the Constitution of India leaves the decision on timing almost entirely to the government. Parliament’s three sessions a year – budget, monsoon and winter sessions – grew out of practice. The Constitution requires only that six months not pass between two sessions.

stories.title: What is surveillance pricing, and why does New York want to ban it?
stories.summary: Take a familiar scenario involving delivery apps and ride-hailing platforms. Two users purchasing the same packet of salted chips at the same time may see different prices. One gets a higher price because an algorithm has inferred from their shopping history, location or other personal information that they are willing to pay more.

stories.title: The expansion of Bhagyalakshmi Temple near Hyderabad’s Charminar | Explained
stories.summary: The Bhagyalakshmi Temple near Charminar in Hyderabad — a small temple built sometime after 1959 — has now expanded to cover much of the nationally protected monument’s south-eastern flank. This Deepavali, the site became the epicenter of massive gridlock after temple officials began distributing free “silver coins” on November 8.

stories.title: Delhi’s air pollution: What can an air purifier really do? | Explained
stories.summary: With Delhi-NCR and adjoining parts of north India reeling under worsening air pollution, demand for air purifiers has surged, particularly after Diwali. Several e-commerce and quick-commerce platforms have reported products going out of stock as residents rush to improve the air quality inside their homes. Available online at prices ranging from around ₹3,500 to ₹56,900, the devices come with varying performance claims, adding to the choices consumers must navigate.

stories.title: Two cases moved from judge's bench: Understanding CJI’s power as master of the roster | HT Explainers
stories.summary: The decision by Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant, in consultation with the four senior-most judges, to shift at least two cases from a bench headed by Justice Ahsanuddin Amanullah has brought back into focus one of the Supreme Court's most consequential and frequently contested powers – the CJI's authority as the master of the roster.

stories.title: Pseudo consent, real debt: RBI’s new battle for responsible microfinance | Explained
stories.summary: The firm stand of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) on the microfinance industry has sent out strong messages that financial inclusion cannot be at the cost of household over-indebtedness and responsible lending begins even before a loan is sanctioned.

stories.title: What’s behind the record ₹89,856-crore FPI surge into Indian equities? | Explained
stories.summary: Amid escalating geopolitical tensions, a boom in the AI sector, and valuation concerns, foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) have been exiting the Indian market for the last two years. However, in a change of course, FPIs have returned to India, and pumped the Indian markets with all-time high inflows of ₹89,856 crore so far in November.

stories.title: HT Explainer: Why Akali Dal (Waris Punjab De) faces registration hurdle ahead of 2027 polls | Hindustan Times
stories.summary: With the 2027 Punjab assembly elections due early next year, the proposed registration of Akali Dal (Waris Punjab De) as a political party has run into a legal and political controversy. The Election Commission of India (ECI) has flagged what it describes as “grave and highly sensitive” inputs against the organisation, raising questions about its alleged separatist links and the implications of granting it political recognition.

stories.title: Rs 4,000 for an Avengers ticket. Mumbai goes big on Doomsday with added shows
stories.summary: The film has also crossed Rs 10 crore in opening-day advance bookings, with about one lakh tickets sold across PVR INOX and Cinepolis within 19 hours of bookings opening. Directed by Anthony and Joe Russo, the film is scheduled to release in India on December 17, a day before its US theatrical debut.

stories.title: Mumbai art scene: Two exhibitions explore playful chaos and the human figure
stories.summary: For Radhika Simoes Kapoor, art does not have to be philosophical. “ Art is fun ,” shares the Art Institute of Chicago alumna. Today, she will open her first show in almost a decade, Collective Chaos, which features works of mixed media that capture spontaneous chaos and, of course, fun.

stories.title: Prince William and Princess Catherine kick off Mumbai visit with chai and cricket alongside Sachin Tendulkar
stories.summary: The Prince and Princess of Wales, William and Catherine, began their three-day official visit to Mumbai with chai and cricket on Monday . Their first public appearance of the day was at Ballard Estate in Fort. 20 am, cricket legend Sachin Tendulkar took the couple to a chai stall that had been set up on the otherwise tightly secured perimeter opposite NTC House on Narottam Morarjee Marg.

stories.title: US man accused of plotting foiled Hindu temple shooting in Illinois faces new charges
stories.summary: Alexandros Paporakis, a 19-year-old resident of Palatine, faces severe charges including terrorism and armed violence after allegedly planning a mass shooting targeting a Hindu temple during the Navaratri festival. Reports from his co-workers contributed to his arrest, during which law enforcement discovered weapons and extremist propaganda. This incident has raised alarms within the Hindu community about escalating hate crimes.
